verified: Payload keys/decimal scalars/booleans/positions match current actual event decoder and projection; exact public post schema excludes owner tags.
Anonymous root and reply preserve canonical root/parent; quote/repost reference existing root while retaining independent own root; empty repost text is required.
Removal preserves original metadata, redacts text and retains navigable prior reply/quote; feed/thread/post expected snapshots all compare current redacted shape.
Same callback performs both like actions; nonzero tags must differ across two posts, counts and unchanged other record fields checked.
Helper owns no wallets/miner/prover/lifecycle, catches no failed action, retries nothing; admission wait occurs once before each post.
Tests include meaningful altered event/metadata/redaction/parent/reference/tag/count and unknown-action failures using explicitly synthetic events.
integration_conditions: Parent must use one captured human wallet/account for both reaction actions; helper cannot authenticate identity of an arbitrary injected callback.
Parent must submit once, retain canonical receipt/effects/fee before semantic assertions, use actual decoder and apply authenticated events before callback return.
Parent must exercise returned expectedHTTP against actual canonical index plus cold reopen; expectedHTTP alone is not network acceptance.
No raising540s/4GiB bounds; parent owns admission waiting/moderator policy and cleanup.
limits: No actual chain/proof/fee/moderation-model/browser acceptance from this test.
Observed cross-post tag difference is not cryptographic unlinkability; two-account duplicate resistance, unlike/re-like and endpoint traces remain required complementary work.
Public moderator and Bok identity are permitted; human-owner protection remains mandatory.
